title: Barcelona - A Bike Friendly City

title: Fantastic
text: Great experience, agatha was so fantastic ! So informative, cared about our safety at all times and taught us a lot. Fantastic
author: ramanw2023

title: Fun, safe, educational. Epic ebike tour with Rory!
text: Absolutely one of the highlights of our mother/son trip to Barcelona! I highly recommend this tour with Rory for anyone who loves recreational bike riding, fresh air, history and all out FUN! Rory was easy to follow as the leader of our bike tour. He provided exceptional, interesting details of many beautiful monuments, parks and seaside gems of Barcelona!He kept us safe and out of traffic which I think puts him in the category of magician as well! Many thanks to Rory and Barcelona eBikes. Highly recommend this one as a bucket list "to do" in Barcelona!
author: cecilialL134YP

title: Barcelona’s Way to See Sights
text: Fun and engaging way to see the sites of Barcelona through our guide, Jairo’s eyes! It was very informative and well planned cycling tour through the highlights of Barcelona.
author: shamlis

title: Highly recommend this bike tour!
text: Aliex was a great tour guide. Engaging and funny. The tour was fun, and mostly on bike lanes. Great pit stop at the beach. Decent bikes as well.

title: Great experience

title: Best experience of whole trip
text: This was my top experience in Barcelona. I ended up getting a solo tour as a large group did not want to split up. My guide customized the tour for me, showed me the most amazing parts of the city, and shared historical perspectives throughout. The e-bike was easy to use and the whole trip was comfortable! My guide was ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
author: 854lindsayr

title: A passionate journey... in space and time
text: Our guide was incredibly knowledgeable and introduced us in a fresh and passionate way to the history of the neighbourhoods we biked through, while making bridges to Picasso's life and art... we strongly recommend this tour!
